diffs.diff: magnetic_field_uT: datasheet reading gives 0.6 per count, the part's model has 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.002995, 0.007634, 0.007634, 0.007634
diffs.evidence: 0.6 uT/count is the AK8963 14-bit mode; the model driver sets CNTL1 = 0x16 (BIT=1, 16-bit) and its magnetometer sub-device uses 0.15 uT/LSB times the ASA adjustment, matching the AK8963 datasheet 'Sensitivity: 0.6 µT/LSB typ. (14-bit)' and '0.15µT/LSB typ. (16-bit)'; the listed model scales are the accel/temp/gyro words, not the magnetometer.

diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 0.01 per count, the part's model has 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.002995, 0.007634, 0.007634, 0.007634
diffs.evidence: The model 0.002995 scale (offset 21) is the MPU-9250 die temperature at 'Sensitivity Untrimmed 333.87 LSB/°C' with a 21 °C offset, while 0.01 °C is the BMP280 compensated output ('resolution is 0.01 DegC'), which the model reproduces through its BMP280 compensation formula rather than a linear scale.
